**Blockchain Developer | ZDOS Creator | Web3 Enthusiast**

I'm building the future of distributed computing with **ZDOS NEXUS** — a unified operating system combining blockchain, AI, and cloud infrastructure.

### 🛠️ **Tech Stack**

## 🚀 **Featured Projects**

### 🌟 **ZDOS NEXUS v3.0**
**Unified Distributed Operating System**

A complete web-app crypto dashboard with 11 integrated modules, cyberpunk UI, real-time monitoring, and production-ready architecture.

**Features:**
- 11 Core Modules (Dashboard, HighCoin, BridgeChain, DSN Wallet, Z-Lang, ZDOS Nodes, Z-GENESIS OS, xCLOUD, Z-STACK CI/CD, HighBrainChain, About)
- Cyberpunk dark/neon theme with HUD effects
- Real-time data updates (5s interval)
- Cross-chain bridge integration
- Self-healing OS simulation
- Cognitive AI layer
- Production-ready build (1.6MB)

**Tech:** React 19 • TypeScript • Tailwind CSS • Express • tRPC • Recharts

📦 **Repository:** [zdos-v3](https://github.com/RZA-pulciz/zdos-v3)
